inputSchema.description: Request schema for updating a check item on a Trello card.

due.description: A due date for the checkitem in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-02-12T07:00:00.000Z')
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: A dueReminder for the due date on the checkitem (number of seconds before due date)
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

idChecklist.description: The ID of the checklist this item is in
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idMember.description: The ID of the member to assign to this check item
idMember.title: Id Member

name.description: The new name for the checklist item
name.title: Name

pos.description: Position of the check item: 'top', 'bottom', or a positive float
pos.title: Pos

inputSchema.title: UpdateCardsChecklistItemsByIdCardByIdChecklistByIdCheckItemRequest

UpdateCardsChecklistItemsByIdCardByIdChe.description: Response schema for updated check item.

due.description: The due date for the check item in ISO 8601 format. Requires Business Class or higher. May be null.
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: The number of seconds before the due date to send a reminder. Requires Business Class or higher. May be null.
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

id.description: The unique identifier of the check item.
id.title: Id

idChecklist.description: The ID of the parent checklist containing this check item.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idMember.description: The ID of the member assigned to this check item. Requires Business Class or higher. May be null.
idMember.title: Id Member

name.description: The text/title of the check item.
name.title: Name

nameData.description: Additional data related to the check item name. Typically null.
nameData.title: Name Data

pos.description: The position of the check item within the checklist, used for ordering.
pos.title: Pos

state.description: The completion state of the check item. Can be 'complete' or 'incomplete'.
state.title: State
